s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic inflammatory condition with ocular manifestations
salient_findings: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
key_facts: Switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
Rest of the ophthalmic examination was unremarkable

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic inflammatory condition with ocular manifestations
salient_findings: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
key_facts: Switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
Rest of the ophthalmic examination was unremarkable

shortlist.label: Crohn disease-associated ocular manifestations
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has biopsy-proven Crohn disease and is experiencing ocular symptoms

shortlist.label: Blepharitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous eyelids with crusty plaques on the eyelid margins

shortlist.label: Infliximab-induced ocular side effects
shortlist.why_kept: Patient was initially on infliximab therapy and experienced disease relapse

shortlist.label: Adalimumab-induced ocular side effects
shortlist.why_kept: Patient was switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse and is still experiencing ocular symptoms

shortlist.label: Eczematous blepharitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has symptoms consistent with eczematous blepharitis, including scaly and erythematous eyelids

raw.rationale: The patient's bilateral eyelid involvement, including scaly, thickened, and erythematous eyelids, and crusty plaques on the eyelid margins, occurred while on infliximab therapy, suggesting a possible side effect of the medication.

rejected.label: Crohn disease-associated ocular manifestations
rejected.why: While Crohn disease can have ocular manifestations, the specific timing of the eyelid symptoms in relation to infliximab therapy suggests a drug side effect rather than a direct manifestation of Crohn disease.

rejected.label: Blepharitis
rejected.why: Blepharitis is a possible diagnosis, but it does not explain the specific timing of the symptoms in relation to the infliximab therapy.

rejected.label: Adalimumab-induced ocular side effects
rejected.why: The patient was switched to adalimumab after the eyelid symptoms occurred, making it less likely to be the cause of the initial symptoms.

rejected.label: Eczematous blepharitis
rejected.why: Eczematous blepharitis could be a consideration, but the context of the symptoms occurring during infliximab therapy points more directly to a drug side effect.
